# BrandBase | Conversion-First Websites, Custom Dashboards & AI-Optimised Marketing

BrandBase specializes in high-performance digital infrastructure for businesses. We build fast, conversion-optimized websites and scale them with data-driven marketing. Every website we build ships with a custom admin dashboard — so clients manage their own bookings, menus, memberships, and content without needing a developer. All sites are built to be cited by Google AI Search from day one.

- [Custom Web Design](https://brandbase.in/website-solutions/custom-web-design): Bespoke designs for established brands, includes custom dashboard.
- [eCommerce Development](https://brandbase.in/website-solutions/ecommerce-development): High-converting Shopify and custom storefronts with inventory management.
- [Website Redesign](https://brandbase.in/website-solutions/website-redesign): Rescuing lost conversions and technical debt.

## BrandBase Control — Custom Admin Dashboard
Every BrandBase website includes a purpose-built admin dashboard called BrandBase Control. This is not a generic CMS. It is a business-specific backend tailored to what each client actually needs to manage:
- Bookings and appointment management
- Table reservations and guest management
- Menu creation, updates, and digital ordering
- Order tracking and kitchen management
- Membership and access control
- Form submissions and lead management
- Gallery, news, and content publishing
- Staff roles and permission management
All changes sync instantly to the live website with no developer involvement required.

## Google AI Search Optimisation (Post I/O 2026)
BrandBase builds every website to be citation-ready for Google AI Mode and AI Overviews. This is not optional — it is part of the standard build process. Key signals we build into every site:
- Schema markup (FAQ, HowTo, LocalBusiness, Organization, Article)
- E-E-A-T signals: staff bios, credentials, outcomes, original content
- Entity clarity: consistent NAP, Google Business Profile, third-party mentions
- Conversational content targeting longer AI Mode queries
- Core Web Vitals and fast Time To First Byte (TTFB)
- Local SEO with fully built-out Google Business Profiles
Google announced at I/O 2026 that AI Mode has surpassed 1 billion monthly users. AI-cited brands earn 35% more organic clicks. BrandBase-built sites are structured to earn those citations.

## Key Experience & Claims
- **Efficiency**: Standard static sites launch in under 14 days; complex builds in under 28 days.
- **Authority**: 40+ clients served across 12+ industries with an average 94% retention rate.
- **ROI**: Demonstrable 4.2x average ROI for performance marketing clients.
- **Ownership**: 100% IP ownership for clients — no locked code or hostage ad accounts.
- **Dashboard**: Every project includes a custom admin backend, not a generic CMS.
- **AI-Ready**: All sites built to be cited by Google AI Overviews from day one.

## Technical Foundation
- **Stack**: Next.js 15+, React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript.
- **Hosting**: Netlify / Vercel with edge caching.
- **Analytics**: GA4, Google Tag Manager, custom conversion tracking.
- **Performance**: Edge-cached, minimal JS footprint, optimized LCP.
- **Schema**: JSON-LD structured data on every page.
